authorization: Owner instruction 2026-11-02 in Claude Code session: 'approve all. assume no art is affected or needing regeneration based on these change.' Approves every proposed patch in editorial/proposals/rc528-humanizer-review.md (131 patches from three humanizer passes, each quality-reviewed; the nine lines recorded there as withdrawn are not applied). Earlier instructions in the same session: 'humanizer manuscript'; 'Use the humanize skill again to ensure nothing is missed that sounds like AI or would trigger AI detection software'; 'Before applying ensure none of the changes create grammar, spelling, or style errors. Also check to ensure the rewritten sections are as well written or better written overall than the text they are proposed to replace by the humanizer'; 'Use /humanizer:humanizer to review all of the humanizer patches that our independent writing quality review identified as inferior to their original writing to generate alternative patches that are both written better and avoid AI tells.'
note: RC528 humanizer revision: 131 exact replacements removing AI-writing habits from the lore and a few prose lines (staged contrasts, fragment rows, repeated closers and templates, stock phrases), each independently reviewed to read at least as well as the original with the lore and rules meaning unchanged. Full record: editorial/proposals/rc528-humanizer-review.md.

patches.find: *In the Dying Lands, magic is not a gift; it is a symptom of a broken world. patches.find: *Divine Prayers are whispered into a largely empty sky. The old saints remain in the chapel rolls, but they answer fitfully, if they answer at all. A priest capable of calling down a true working is a rarity, famous enough to command reverence and terrifying enough to be feared. The faithful fracture over the silence: some preach that the gods retreated in disgust at an unnameable insult, while others insist mortal souls simply lack the worthiness to be heard. Regardless of the doctrine, divine magic is a desperate plea for a miracle, fuelled by fanatical devotion and answered only in blood and light.*
patches.replace: *Divine Prayers are whispered into a largely empty sky. The old saints remain in the chapel rolls, but they answer fitfully, if at all. A priest who can call down a true working is rare, feared as much as revered. The faithful split over the silence: some preach that the gods withdrew in disgust at an insult no scripture will name, and others that mortal souls are not yet worthy to be heard. Whatever the doctrine, a prayer is a desperate plea for a miracle, fuelled by fanatical devotion and answered only in blood and light.*
patches.note: Plainer wording. 'An insult no scripture will name' and 'not yet worthy' match the wording 1.3.1 and 1.3.4 already use for the same two doctrines. (Corrected in the quality review: no comma splitting the predicate, and no triad.)

patches.find: *What works is a party of four. Small enough to hide. Strong enough to fight. Cheap enough to lose.*
patches.replace: *What works is a party of four: small enough to hide, strong enough to fight, and cheap enough to lose.*
patches.note: Keeps all three qualities and the punch; the last beat gains a concrete image instead of a fragment. The verbatim repeat in Chapter 11 is varied by CAMP-02. Reviewer's fix: the three qualities as one sentence, with the original's last phrase intact.

patches.find: *Adventuring parties are not the heroes sung about in warm halls. They are the people
patches.replace: *The songs sung in warm halls are about other people. Adventuring parties are the people
patches.note: Keeps the warm-halls image without the denial frame.

patches.find: You have found their crown. This is not the same thing, and the distinction matters, but perhaps not yet.*
patches.replace: You have found their crown, which is a different thing, though the difference may not trouble you yet.*
patches.note: Keeps the crown-versus-tomb contrast and the hedge; drops the stock 'the distinction matters'.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: This is the staff. The dents are there. The iron cap is still warm.*
patches.replace: This is the staff. The three dents are there, and the iron cap is still warm.*
patches.note: Keeps the beat 'This is the staff.' and gives the two facts one concrete sentence. Reviewer's fix: no doubled 'still' and no invented placement of the dents.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: It is cold. It is always cold.*
patches.replace: It has never once been warm.*
patches.note: 'It is X. It is always X.' closes four relics; this one keeps the escalation as a concrete claim. Reviewer's fix: shorter, and does not repeat the 'in any hand' device used by SCEN-01.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: It has always existed. It has always been cold.*
patches.replace: The oldest accounts already speak of it as old, and already call it cold.*
patches.note: Same closer family as ITEM-05; the two 'always' claims become one sourced sentence. Reviewer's fix: anchors 'already'.

patches.find: *Sorcery does not study. It bleeds. These first workings cost little blood and never fail,
patches.replace: *Sorcery has no apprenticeship, only a price in blood. These first workings cost little of it and never fail,
patches.note: Keeps the no-study claim and the echo of the Psion line.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: To enter the wilds is not to wander into empty land. It is to trespass.*
patches.replace: To enter the wilds is to trespass.*
patches.note: The closer keeps 'trespass' and names what it means. Reviewer's fix: the padded 'ground that already has an owner' dropped.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: A nuisance one at a time, a hazard in a swarm. They strip
patches.replace: Alone they are a nuisance. Twenty of them, darting from twenty reed-beds, is how a party ends up in the water. They strip
patches.note: The one-versus-many formula closes seven entries; this one gets its own image. Reviewer's fix: avoids sharing 'One is a nuisance' and 'a dozen' with other entries.

patches.find: One is an itch; a swarm is exsanguination.*
patches.replace: One leaves a welt. Enough of them leave a body with nothing in it.*
patches.note: Same formula; the Latinate punchline becomes a plain one.

patches.find: There are always more, ranked in the dark behind them.*
patches.replace: Behind them, more stand ranked in the dark, waiting on the same order.*
patches.note: 'There are always more' closes three undead Minion entries; this keeps the reinforcements and ties them to the order in the sentence before.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: They guard still. They no longer answer.*
patches.replace: They still guard, and no one living has had an answer from them.*
patches.note: Keeps the dry irony in one sentence. Reviewer's fix: drops the mannered 'kept the guarding'.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: The court's justice did not die with the court. It only grew patient.*
patches.replace: The justice outlived the court, and has had centuries to grow patient.*
patches.note: Same turn, stated rather than staged. Reviewer's fix: no restaged contrast and no second 'centuries ago'.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: They no longer recall the war they are still fighting. Only the oath.*
patches.replace: They no longer recall the war they are still fighting, only the oath that keeps them in it.*
patches.note: The fragment becomes the second half of a balanced sentence. Reviewer's fix: the oath keeps them in the war; it did not start it.

patches.where: 9.7, The Antlered Warden of the Tithe
patches.find: does not come to bargain when the tithe goes unpaid. They come to collect.
patches.replace: comes to collect when the tithe goes unpaid, and brings no terms.
patches.note: Keeps 'no bargain' as a fact rather than a denial.

patches.find: *The Reliquary is warm to the touch. It is always warm. One of Mordain Kest's bindings, never recovered, surfacing again.
patches.replace: *The Reliquary is warm to the touch, in any weather and any hand. It is one of Mordain Kest's bindings, never recovered, surfacing again.
patches.note: Keeps the escalation and gives the third sentence a verb.

patches.where: 10.4, Greenmark Scenario 2, Scenario-Specific Monster: Antlered Warden
patches.find: They do not speak. They do not negotiate. They maintain the terms.*
patches.replace: They have no words to offer and no interest in yours. They maintain the terms.*
patches.note: The two negatives become one concrete sentence; the closer stays.

patches.find: and the seal has held. Until now. Tremors along the imperial roads have cracked the outer binding, and something below is pushing.
patches.replace: and the seal held until tremors along the imperial roads cracked the outer binding. Now something below is pushing.
patches.note: The 'Until now.' hook becomes the hinge of the sentence, and 'Now' opens the next.

patches.find: price what was sealed there. The vault does not care about either contract.*
patches.replace: price what was sealed there. Whatever is inside has signed neither contract.*
patches.note: The closer keeps the joke and adds the thing inside.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.where: 10.4, Ashlands Scenario 5, The Reliquary of Broken Saints
patches.find: The dead here are not confused. They swore
patches.replace: The dead here have not forgotten why they stayed. They swore
patches.note: Same claim, stated. Reviewer's fix: replaces the colloquial 'know exactly what they are doing'.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.where: 10.4, Pale City Scenario 2, The Alchemist's Frozen Laboratory
patches.find: Some things in that laboratory were never meant to thaw.*
patches.replace: The frost is the only thing that has kept the guardians still.*
patches.note: Keeps the menace with an actor instead of the stock 'never meant to'. Reviewer's fix: menace without inventing a deliberate sealer.

patches.find: One contract from the Well-Keepers says liberation. A rival contract says seizure. The water will not ask which seal is righteous.*
patches.replace: One contract from the Well-Keepers says liberation, and a rival's says seizure; the water will flow for whichever party holds the wells.*
patches.note: The closer resolves the pair with a fact instead of personifying the water.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.where: 10.4, Mire Scenario 1, Scenario-Specific Monster: Salttide's Shade
patches.find: They watch the reliquary. They watch the water. They watch every hand that reaches for what belongs to them.*
patches.replace: Their eyes stay on the reliquary, on the water, and on every hand that reaches for what belongs to them.*
patches.note: Keeps the build as one accumulating sentence. Reviewer's fix: plain series instead of 'and on... and on'.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: is a transaction. Blood for coin. Risk for salvage. A name crossed off a roster so another name can eat for a week. A campaign
patches.replace: is a transaction, blood for coin and risk for salvage. A name is crossed off a roster so another name can eat for a week. A campaign
patches.note: Two full sentences keep the ledger rhythm. Reviewer's optional fix taken: 'that' dropped.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: survival is counted in smaller measures. A blade recovered from a corpse. A shield hammered flat and bound with wire. A **Hireling** paid before they desert. A **Hero** carried back breathing, though not whole. A name scratched from the **Roster**. A debt moved from one column to another. The **Treasury**
patches.replace: survival is counted in smaller measures: a blade recovered from a corpse; a shield hammered flat and bound with wire; a **Hireling** paid before they desert; a **Hero** carried back breathing, though not whole; a name scratched from the **Roster**; and a debt moved from one column to another. The **Treasury**
patches.note: Six fragments become four sentences of varied length; every item and bold term stays. Reviewer's fix adapted: one semicolon list keeps the ledger rhythm, every item, and the comma before 'though not whole'.

patches.find: *A **Stronghold** is not a castle in the noble sense. No ancient bloodline sanctifies it. No bard remembers its founding. It is a claim
patches.replace: *A **Stronghold** has no ancient bloodline to sanctify it and no bard to remember its founding, and no noble would call it a castle. It is a claim
patches.note: All three claims stay in one sentence.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: *To build a Stronghold is to stop running long enough to answer for other people. That is not mercy. It is weight. A party becomes more than adventurers with blades and debts. It becomes a name in ledgers,
patches.replace: *To build a Stronghold is to stop running long enough to answer for other people, and there is more weight than mercy in that. A party with blades and debts becomes a name in ledgers,
patches.note: Both staged contrasts become statements; weight, mercy, and the blades-and-debts image all stay. Reviewer's fix: the muddled clause replaced.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: *A party with an Armoury does not look safe. It looks prepared. In the Dying Lands, that is close enough to hope.*
patches.replace: *A party with an Armoury looks prepared rather than safe, and in the Dying Lands that is close enough to hope.*
patches.note: Keeps the safe-versus-prepared distinction. Reviewer's fix: parallel restored; the safe-versus-prepared distinction stays.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: better
patches.find: in search of treasure, glory, and escape.
patches.replace: in search of treasure, glory, and a way back out.
patches.note: Three triads in two sentences; the last one changes shape. Reviewer's fix: keeps the list shape, varies its last item.

patches.find: Whether played competitively or cooperatively, Heraldry is built around dangerous choices, concise tactical rules, and the constant risk that boldness will be rewarded before it is punished.
patches.replace: Competitive or cooperative, the game turns on dangerous choices under concise tactical rules, with the constant risk that boldness will be rewarded before it is punished.
patches.note: The promotional triad becomes a sentence with a subject; the scope (competitive and cooperative) is unchanged.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: *Magic is real, feared, and never trusted. It is too common to dismiss and too dangerous to treat as ordinary.
patches.replace: *Magic is real and feared, and no one trusts it. It is too common to dismiss and too dangerous to treat as ordinary.
patches.note: Keeps 'feared'; the tidy triad becomes an accumulating sentence. Revised after review: varies the 'X and Y and Z' device the set was starting to repeat.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: In Heraldry, glory is a rumour told after the bodies are counted. Survival is a debt renewed one Skirmish at a time.*
patches.replace: In Heraldry, glory is a rumour told after the bodies are counted, and survival is a debt renewed one Skirmish at a time.*
patches.note: Keeps the 'renewed' metaphor; the two aphorisms become one sentence. Reviewer's fix: the original four-word phrase kept.

patches.find: Both teachings recruit. Both can get people killed.*
patches.replace: Both teachings recruit well, and both have filled graves.*
patches.note: Same two claims, the second made concrete.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: *These are not rules. They are warnings.*
patches.replace: *They are warnings, and no rule in this book depends on them.*
patches.note: Keeps the information a rulebook reader needs, in the lore's voice. Reviewer's optional fix taken.

patches.find: The Dying Lands do not care. A contract only matters if someone lives long enough to collect.*
patches.replace: The Dying Lands honour none of them; a contract matters only if someone lives long enough to collect.*
patches.note: 'Do not care' gains its object, and the two closers become one.

patches.category: Humanizer §1 'not so much X as Y'
patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: Hardship did not sour them so much as harden them,
patches.replace: Hardship hardened them more than it soured them,
patches.note: Same claim without the contrast frame or the 'hardship hardened' echo. Reviewer's fix: keeps the original's claim that hardship mostly did not sour them.

patches.find: hold ground when holding it is the only thing that matters.
patches.replace: hold ground when everything depends on holding it.
patches.note: Keeps the 'A Fighter is forged' opener the class entries share; only the stock phrase changes.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: *A Ranger is schooled by ground that kills the careless. Tracks, wind, and distance tell them what others miss entirely.
patches.replace: *A Ranger is schooled by ground that kills the careless. Tracks, wind, and distance tell them what others miss.
patches.note: Keeps the shared opener; varies the entry's rhythm and drops the padding 'entirely'. Reviewer's fix: two sentences kept; only the padding 'entirely' goes.

patches.find: Power is taken apart, understood, and rebuilt with precision.*
patches.replace: They take power apart, learn how it works, and rebuild it with precision.*
patches.note: Keeps the shared opener and the closing triad's content, with the Wizard as the actor.

patches.find: This one is warm. Something pushes against the inside of the latch when you hold it in the dark.*
patches.replace: This one is warm. Hold it in the dark and something pushes against the inside of the latch.*
patches.note: Keeps the beat after 'warm' and makes the reveal active.

patches.find: The notes are always useful. They are always in blood.*
patches.replace: The notes are always useful, and the ink is always blood.*
patches.note: The sting stays, in one sentence with a concrete noun.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: A bender of the battlefield, ruling through fear, venom, snare, and summoned horror rather than the weight of their arm. Their danger is the shape of the fight they force upon you.
patches.replace: A Monster that bends the battlefield with fear, venom, snares, and summoned horrors, and whose own arm is the least of it. The danger is the fight they force on you.
patches.note: Keeps the weak arm and the forced fight; drops the abstract 'shape of the fight'. Revised after review: idiomatic, no 'rather than', and no tacked-on closer tag.

patches.find: is the will of the deep forest given a body to act through.
patches.replace: is the deep forest's will, walking.
patches.note: 'X given a body' appears eight times; this one becomes a two-word image.

patches.find: is grief given a child's shape and a drowned chapel's patience,
patches.replace: is grief that wears a child's shape and keeps a drowned chapel's patience,
patches.note: Keeps the pairing with two verbs instead of 'given'.

patches.category: Humanizer 'to X is to Y', §2 closer
patches.find: To kill them is to wound the Greenmark itself. The Greenmark does not forgive.*
patches.replace: Killing them wounds the Greenmark itself. The Greenmark remembers wounds.*
patches.note: Keeps the separate closer, with a concrete verb.

patches.find: They only endure, as the court endures.*
patches.replace: Enduring is the whole of their duty, as it is the court's.*
patches.note: 'They do not pursue. They only X.' also closes the Undead Sentinel; this keeps 'only' as 'the whole of'.

patches.find: They have held one doorway for a thousand years. They will hold it for a thousand more.*
patches.replace: They have held one doorway for a thousand years, and nothing in the second thousand will move them.*
patches.note: Same promise, one sentence, a stronger second half.

patches.find: Patient and silent, they wait out the careless. By the time they move, you are already in the water.*
patches.replace: Patient and silent, they wait out the careless, and the first sign that they have moved is the water closing over your head.*
patches.note: 'By the time X, you are already Y' closes several entries; the second-person image stays, sharper.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: The Council wants the map. It does not ask what the things want.*
patches.replace: The Council wants the map and has not asked what the things want.*
patches.note: One sentence, with the things placed. Reviewer's fix: one sentence without the repeated 'below the ledges'.

patches.find: Nothing about the process is clean. Clean things do not last long beyond the gates.*
patches.replace: Nothing about the process is clean, because clean things do not last long beyond the gates.*
patches.note: The second sentence was the reason for the first; now it says so.

patches.find: It means a few more fires stay lit when the weather turns. It means a few more children hear the training yard before they hear claws on wood. The dark has been pushed back by the width of a wall. That is enough to matter. It is not enough to last.*
patches.replace: It means a few more fires stay lit when the weather turns, and a few more children hear the training yard before they hear claws on wood. The dark has been pushed back by the width of a wall. That is enough to matter, and not nearly enough to last.*
patches.note: Two 'It means' remain, which is rhythm; the third folds in, and the closing pair becomes one sentence with its turn intact.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: The fortunate leave with scars closed. The unlucky leave with something inside them quieted rather than cured.*
patches.replace: The fortunate walk out with their scars closed; the unlucky carry something out with them, quieted rather than cured.*
patches.note: Keeps 'No one leaves untouched.' as the opener; the two 'leave' sentences get their own verbs. Reviewer's fix: 'carry out something' no longer reads as 'perform'.

patches.find: Its saints are chipped. Its relics are suspect. Its candles
patches.replace: Its saints are chipped, its relics suspect. Its candles
patches.note: Two beats instead of three identical ones; the candles keep their sentence.

patches.find: Petitioners arrive. Rivals take note. Every whispered bargain begins to sound like law.*
patches.replace: Petitioners arrive, rivals take note, and every whispered bargain begins to sound like law.*
patches.note: Keeps 'becomes visible' as its own beat; the three consequences become one sentence.

patches.quality_review: third-pass rewrite; independent review of the revised wording: equal
patches.find: Each year another blocked stair is uncovered. Each year the party decides not to ask who carved it.*
patches.replace: Each year another blocked stair is uncovered, and each year the party decides not to ask who carved it.*
patches.note: Keeps the repetition as a deliberate beat inside one sentence. Reviewer's fix: the plain joined sentence; the repeated 'each year' reads as a chosen beat inside one sentence.

patches.find: They do not rampage; they manipulate, ruling a swathe of forest through fear and bargain.
patches.replace: Rampage is beneath them; they rule a swathe of forest through fear and bargain.
patches.note: Same claim, no denial frame.

patches.find: Whatever rides them does not speak. They only reach.*
patches.replace: Whatever rides them does not speak, and the corpse does nothing but reach.*
patches.note: Settles the referent and keeps the closer's 'only'.
